1. Platinum Rewards Card: Rebate Eligibility and Calcluation
   ID: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_010
   Score: 45.7495
   Content: ## Eligibility for the Annual Fee Rebate

- The Platinum Rewards Card annual fee rebate is earned only if you meet the required monthly spending threshold in every month of your cardmember year.
- A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.
- If your first cardmember year’s annual fee is waived under a promotional offer, the rebate does not apply to that year. Eligibility begins with the next cardmember year in which the annual fee is billed.

## How the Monthly Calculation Window Works

- Start date: Your first monthly window begins on your account opening date.
- Refresh cadence: Each new monthly window begins on the same calendar day each month (the monthly anniversary of your account opening) and ends the day before the next monthly anniversary.
- Cardmember year: Your rebate evaluation covers 12 consecutive monthly windows, starting from your account opening date (or from the start of the first fee-billed cardmember year after any promotional waiver).
- Posting date rule: Only transactions that post within a given monthly window count toward that month’s threshold. Authorization dates do not control eligibility.

1. Silver Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?
   ID: doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_006
   Score: 30.6885
   Content: ## How interest is calculated
- Your applicable APY depends on your balance tier and may be either 2.5% or 4.0%.
- Interest accrues on your daily balance and is compounded daily. We calculate a daily periodic rate from your APY and apply it to the balance for each day of the cycle.

## When interest is paid
- Accrued interest is credited to your account monthly.

## Credit card APY bonuses
- Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Silver Account:
  - Bronze Rewards Card: +0%
  - Silver Rewards Card: +0.1%
  - Gold Rewards Card: +0.5%
  - EcoCard: +2.2%
  - Green Rewards Card: +0%
  - Crypto-Cash Back Card: +0.5%

## Practical notes
- If your balance moves between tiers during a cycle, the applicable APY for each day is based on that day's balance. Interest for the cycle is the sum of each day's accrual.

- Search the knowledge base to confirm the specific card has a documented referral program.

## How the user generates their referral link
- Provide the customer with this tool and instruct them to run it themselves:
  - `get_referral_link(user_id: str, card_name: str)`
- Tell the customer to pass their own user_id and the exact card name (for example, 'Gold Rewards Card').
- When the tool is called successfully, a referral record is created with status 'NO_PROGRESS'. The referred person can then use the generated link to apply.

## Important reminders
- Weekly limit: Customers can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the third and subsequent referrals in that window are automatically denied.
- Agents must not generate the link on the customer’s behalf.
- Reiterate the correct referral terms as documented to prevent confusion and complaints.

What you should know about the Silver Rewards Card
- Eligibility: minimum credit score ~680 (subject to underwriting).

- Annual income (you provided $95,000 — I’ve noted that).

How to apply (quick steps)
1) Sign in to Rho‑Bank online banking or the mobile app. 
2) Go to the Credit Cards / Apply section and choose “Silver Rewards Card.” 
3) Fill in your personal and financial details, consent to the credit check, and submit. 
4) You’ll get a decision or a request for additional documentation. If approved, activate the card when it arrives.

Thanks — that status is normal. Here’s exactly what to expect and what you can do now to make the underwriting review go smoothly.

What the message means
- “Pending / additional review” simply means underwriting needs to verify some information before issuing a final decision. The 5–7 business day window is the typical timeframe for them to review and (if needed) request specific documents.

Common documents underwriting may request
(Do not upload these in chat — upload only via the secure portal when requested.)
- Proof of income
  - Recent pay stubs (most recent 1–3 pay periods) or employer income verification letter
  - W‑2(s) or 1040 tax return (especially if self‑employed)
  - Bank statements showing direct deposits (if pay stubs aren’t available)
- Government ID
  - Driver’s license or passport (photo page) showing your full name and DOB
- Proof of address
  - Utility bill, bank statement, lease, or official government mail with your name and 3421 Sakura Avenue
- Additional items (less common)
  - Recent bank statements, employment verification letter, or explanation for large deposits/outsized balances

Accepted formats & upload tips
- Preferred formats: PDF, JPG, PNG or clear screenshots.
- Make sure documents are: legible, unredacted, not password‑protected, and show your name and the relevant dates.
- If you’re self‑employed, a recent tax return (1040) and schedule(s) are often the fastest proof.
- If a document contains multiple pages, combine into a single PDF if possible and label files clearly (see naming suggestions below).

How to upload (general steps)
1. Sign in to your Rho‑Bank account (website or mobile app).  
2. Go to Applications / Messages / Documents (or the application details page) and open the Silver Rewards Card application.  
3. If underwriting requests docs you’ll see an “Upload documents” button or an instruction that links to a secure upload area.  
4. Choose the correct document type from the dropdown (if shown), attach the file(s), and click Upload / Submit.  
5. Wait for a confirmation message in the portal (or email). Keep copies for your records.

Filenames (suggested)
- Yuki_Nakamura_Paystub_2025-10.pdf
- Yuki_Nakamura_DriverLicense.jpg
- Yuki_Nakamura_ProofAddress_Utility_2025-09.pdf
Clear filenames help underwriting route things faster.

Security & phishing reminder
- Only upload documents through your secure account portal. Rho will not ask you to send SSNs or copies of IDs over open email or this chat.
- If you get an email asking for docs, confirm it’s from an official Rho‑Bank domain and that it links to your logged‑in portal before uploading.

After you upload
- You should receive confirmation in the portal and an updated status. Underwriting may still request follow-ups; respond promptly to avoid delays.
- If approved, you’ll see an approval message and expected shipping time for your card. If denied, you’ll get an adverse action notice with next steps.

How I can help right now
- I can prepare a tailored checklist (with exact filenames to use) for the likely documents based on your situation (employed vs self‑employed).
